snippet.title: Mesektet - Trailer
snippet.description:
The recent discovery of an archaeological site has piqued the Vatican's interest, so Elizabeth has traveled to Turkey with the objective of investigating the hill of Göbekli Tepehe, where the unearthed ruins of the ancient religious sanctuary could reveal the origin of civilization.
